title: A Critical Value for the Viscosity Coefficient: Triggering Oscillatory Traveling Waves in the Pseudo-parabolic Fisher-KPP Equation
summary: The pseudo-parabolic term $u_{xxt}$ serves as a canonical example of higher-order viscosity that provides effective regularization while capturing the refined physical mechanism. How it alters the dynamics of prototype equations remains a fundamental issue, which is not yet fully understood.
